issue.title: Fix Docker Compose Dev Services NPE on Docker v29

body:
Thanks for the report! 

Could something as simple as https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/51247 fix the issue?
I'll build it locally and test it, gimme a sec
Just tested it and this indeed fixed our issue, thanks!
Hi @LarsSven, did you find any workaround in the meantime? Thanks
